raw_record.question_text: A group of scientists wished to learn about the energy efficiency of different modes of locomotion. They studied the literature based on accurate measurements and produced a graph from the data they analyzed. Based on this graph, what did the scientists discover?
raw_record.standard_answer: Running is the least energy-efficient means of locomotion

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a log-log graph of energy cost versus body mass with separate labeled lines for flying, swimming, and running. Then use the y-axis meaning to rank efficiency: higher vertical position means greater energy cost. Since the running trend line lies highest relative to the other modes where they can be compared, conclude that running requires the most energy per unit mass per unit distance and is therefore the least energy-efficient mode of locomotion.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个双对数坐标图，横轴标为“Body mass (g) (log scale)”，纵轴标为“Energy cost (cal/kg·m) log scale”。图中有三条分别标注为 Flying、Swimming 和 Running 的趋势线。Running 的趋势线在可比较范围内位于较高的纵向位置，Swimming 的线较低，Flying 也低于或不高于 Running。推理：纵轴表示单位质量、单位距离的能量消耗；纵向位置越高，表示能量成本越大，能量效率越低。因此，Running 需要的能量成本最高，所以科学家发现跑步是能量效率最低的运动方式。
method.model_answer: Running is the least energy-efficient means of locomotion.
